name: GuardianEye
tagline: A dashboard that watches live camera feeds for falls, fire or distress and alerts family members.
problem: Older relatives with dementia fall at home and are not always found quickly, the team says.
solution: Computer vision on phone or body-cam feeds detects falls, smoke and inactivity; an agent layer raises alerts by phone message.
demo_moment: Team-described: a simulated fall triggers an alert on the dashboard.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “BluePrint Social Good Track” among 217 submissions.
Grew out of team members' grandparents' falls.

lessons: Personal stakes make a monitoring demo land with social-good judges.
